    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    sep = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] != 0 for r in range(h))), w // 2)

    return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][sep + 1 + c] != 0 else 0
